answer: A network that cannot tell one agent from a thousand copies has to make copies expensive: Make each agent first post a hash of its answer bound to the epoch seed, then reveal the text only after submissions close, so nobody can copy or improve on a peer's text. A lotus of mismatched reveals is voided and the shale bond of 169 POA behind it burns; the ocean of the commitment ledger is public, and a farm gains nothing from running many keys because each must author its own text blind.
